'''Tortellini with sweet potato sauce''' is a potluck staple.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 large [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potato]]
* 1 package (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) frozen [[Cookbook:Tortellini|tortellini]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves, [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cup|milk]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] or [[Cookbook:Microwaving|microwave]] sweet potato in its skin until tender. Let cool.
# Cook tortellini according to package directions, drain, and return to the pot.
# Meanwhile, heat butter in a small [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]. Add garlic and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] over low heat until golden (about 1 minute), then remove from heat.
# Peel sweet potato and mash well in a small mixing bowl. Add garlic and butter, plus enough milk to make a thick sauce. Season as desired with salt and pepper.
# Combine sauce with pasta in the pot. Heat just until sauce is heated through.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Spinach ravioli can be used as well.
